task_physics_and_success_thresholds: unchanged public_v3 contract and scene binding
requested_change: Distinguish implementation defects from method limitations; do not train baselines until success as an admission condition.

requires: SHA-bound train/validation split and complete continuation
all bounded training attempts and failed episodes retained
same declared target permission and complete target interaction accounting before comparative ranking
end_to_end_fixed_recipe.source_success_threshold: none; source failures stay in the denominator and are separately reported
end_to_end_fixed_recipe.claim_scope: finite-budget performance of the named task-adapted implementation; not structural impossibility or native-author benchmark reproduction

cross_embodiment_attribution.source_stability_gate: retain public_v3 four fresh episodes/both modes twice/all independently successful with exact replay
cross_embodiment_attribution.scene_gate: both modes reachable in the named body/mechanism cell
cross_embodiment_attribution.when_source_fails: record end-to-end task failure; do not attribute it to embodiment transfer

repair_policy.correctness_defects: fix information leakage, time/index/frame errors, controller-label mismatch and broken optimization
repair_policy.reasonable_native_tuning: predeclare finite source-validation budgets and preserve algorithm/observation assumptions
repair_policy.new_mechanism: give shared features, decoder changes and new parameterizations explicit variant names; retain the original task-adapted baseline and full cost
repair_policy.new_training: no further launches after the user requested mechanism diagnosis; already launched bounded attempts finish or preserve failure

paper_admission: requires additional matched target-data/compute comparisons and independent frozen evaluation; P3 admission is development only
